# EarthDaily documentation


> Everything you need to know to master EarthDaily services


EarthDaily Analytics provides satellite imagery and geospatial analytics for agriculture, insurance, and environmental monitoring. For a full overview of EarthDaily's products and services, visit [earthdaily.com](https://earthdaily.com).


## Full documentation

- [All sections](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full.txt): Complete content for all included sections (~84k tokens)
- [Agriculture > ANALYTIC CATALOG](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-agriculture-analytic-catalog.txt): Full content for Agriculture > ANALYTIC CATALOG (~35k tokens)
- [Data > EarthPlatform](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-data-earthplatform.txt): Full content for Data > EarthPlatform (~17k tokens)
- [Data > EarthOne](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-data-earthone.txt): Full content for Data > EarthOne (~10k tokens)
- [Data > Collections](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-data-collections.txt): Full content for Data > Collections (~3k tokens)
- [Mining](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-mining.txt): Full content for Mining (~228 tokens)
- [Mining > Marigold](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/llms-full-mining-marigold.txt): Full content for Mining > Marigold (~12k tokens)

## Mining > Iris

- [Introduction](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/getting-started/iris-introduction/): An online interface for viewing and analyzing InSAR deformation results over engineered infrastructure sites (~479 tokens)
- [The Iris Interface](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/getting-started/the-iris-interface/): Guide to the layout and design of Iris — data panel, navigation, map window, and deformation plots (~2k tokens)
- [Data Layers](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/getting-started/data-layers-in-iris/): Guide to GDS analysis data layers — LOS, East-West-Vertical, spatial filtering, velocity, acceleration, and coherence (~993 tokens)
- [Anomaly Detection](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/getting-started/anomaly-detection/): Understand changes at your site with confidence — steady, sudden, and complex anomaly detection in Iris (~817 tokens)
- [DEM-Error Corrected Points](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/technical-methodology/dem-error-corrected-point-locations/): Iris 1.5.0: improved location accuracy in areas where the digital elevation model differs from actual ground elevation (~685 tokens)
- [Historical Consistency](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/technical-methodology/historical-consistency/): Understanding historical inconsistencies in Iris InSAR analyses and tools to assess the history problem (~898 tokens)
- [Spatial Filtering](https://earthdaily.github.io/documentation/mining/iris/technical-methodology/spatial-filtering-in-iris/): Guide to spatial filtering in Iris — filtered vs unfiltered data layers and when to use each (~781 tokens)
